run_qr_web_server: run a python module that generates a QR code from a string and serves it on an HTTP server on port 8000
create_qrcode_from_string: create a QR code image from a string and save it as qrcode.png in the current directory
serve_qrcode_over_http: serve a QR code image over HTTP on port 8000 with an HTML page displaying the code
review_http_handler_class: review the HTTPHandler class that handles GET requests for PNG images and HTML content
refactor_qrcode_generation: refactor the makeQRCode function to support custom output paths and image formats
